title: Delegate composition pipeline
prompt: Implement `static Func<string, string> Pipeline(params Func<string, string>[] steps)` returning one delegate applying steps left to right (step 1 first). Also implement `static Func<int> Memoize(Func<int> f)` — no, simpler: implement `static int InvokeThrice(Func<int> f)` that calls f exactly three times and returns the last result (tests that delegates are first-class values).

tests.name: pipeline-order
tests.hint: Fold the array: acc = acc + step for each step in order.
